attachments.origin_landmark: sternal head: manubrium; clavicular head: medial third of clavicle
attachments.insertion_landmark: mastoid process and lateral superior nuchal line

actions: unilateral: laterally flexes neck to the same side + rotates face to the opposite side
bilateral: flexes neck / protracts head, assists forced inspiration by fixing/elevating the sternum

functional_compartments.name: Sternal head
functional_compartments.function_note: Rounder, more superficial head arising from the manubrium.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)

functional_compartments.name: Clavicular head
functional_compartments.function_note: Broader, flatter, deeper head arising from the medial clavicle; the two heads are separated by a palpable triangular gap (the lesser supraclavicular fossa) at their origin.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)

source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)
